stories.label: Iran-US-Israel war: regional conflict spreading, school death toll 148
stories.summary: US-Israel strikes on Iran continue into Day 2. School strike death toll rose to 148; Israel denies awareness. IRGC launching fresh waves of attacks on Israel and Gulf states. Strait of Hormuz disrupted. Explosions reported in Tehran, Riyadh, Dubai, Doha, Manama.

stories.label: Khamenei killed: interim council formed, Larijani emerges as power broker
stories.summary: Supreme Leader Khamenei confirmed dead. Iran formed interim leadership council: Ayatollah Arafi, president, chief justice. Assembly of Experts has not convened. Pragmatist Ali Larijani emerging as key power broker. Street reaction split between mourning and celebration.

stories.label: Iran school strike: death toll climbs from 1 to 148, war crimes accused
stories.summary: Death toll from strike on Iranian school rose from 1 confirmed (last cycle) to 148 (this cycle). Israel says 'not aware' of operations in the area. US 'looking into reports.' Schools are protected under international humanitarian law.

stories.label: Pakistan erupts: 9 killed in protests, curfew imposed, consulates stormed
stories.summary: Nine killed by gunfire at US Consulate in Karachi. UN offices burned in Skardu and Gilgit. Curfew imposed, army called in. Section 144 across Punjab. PM cancelled Russia visit. 10 million Pakistani workers in Gulf states at risk.

stories.label: US intelligence shared Khamenei location with Israel, enabling strike
stories.summary: US officials disclosed Khamenei's location in Tehran to Israel. May violate Executive Order 12333. Accountability for who authorised the disclosure remains unresolved.

stories.label: OPEC+ boosts output 206K bpd as Hormuz disrupted — inadequate vs 20M bpd transit
stories.summary: OPEC+ agreed 206,000 bpd output increase starting April. Russia agreed. Strait of Hormuz normally carries ~20M bpd. The increase is symbolic — 1% of disrupted transit. Oil prices spiking. Fuel-importing nations in Africa and South Asia hardest hit.

stories.label: Anthropic rejects Pentagon demand — CEO says no to dropping AI safeguards
stories.summary: Anthropic's CEO rejected Pentagon's Feb 27 deadline to drop military use restrictions. Defense Secretary Hegseth had threatened 'supply chain risk' designation. Outcome of that threat still unclear. Story has advanced from threat to refusal.

stories.label: World-first: stem cells treat spina bifida in the womb
stories.summary: First-in-human fetal stem cell therapy for spina bifida shows promise. Published in Nature. Intervenes before birth to prevent damage rather than repair it after. Affects ~1 in 1,000 pregnancies globally.

stories.label: Fungicide health effects persist 20 generations in rats — epigenetic inheritance
stories.summary: Nature study: single exposure to common agricultural fungicide caused health effects persisting 20 generations in rats via epigenetic inheritance. In human terms, ~500 years. Raises fundamental questions about chemical safety testing that only evaluates single-generation toxicity.

stories.label: North Korea condemns Iran strikes: geopolitical bloc crystallising
stories.summary: North Korea called attacks 'illegal aggression.' Signals alignment of Russia-North Korea-Iran bloc. Kim views Khamenei killing as precedent for what could happen to him.

stories.label: Syria three-front crisis — al-Hol mass escape adds to Assad remnant and IS threats
stories.summary: Syria fighting on three fronts. Iran war may divert attention and resources — watch for IS exploitation of vacuum.

stories.label: Myanmar junta bombs Rakhine — war continues with minimal attention
stories.summary: Military air strikes killed 17 at village market in Rakhine. Further obscured by Iran war.

stories.label: Zimbabwe bans all raw mineral and lithium exports
stories.summary: Zimbabwe imposed ban on export of all raw minerals and lithium concentrate. Africa's largest lithium reserves. Chinese firms primary buyers.

stories.label: Israel orders 37 aid organizations to halt operations in Gaza
stories.summary: 37 aid groups ordered to halt. Rafah crossing now closed amid Iran strikes. Humanitarian access deteriorating. Uncovered for two cycles.

stories.label: Israeli forces fired 900+ bullets killing 15 Gaza medics execution-style
stories.summary: Forensic investigation found 900+ bullets fired at aid workers. Gaza operations may intensify as IDF resources pivot to Iran front.

stories.label: Sudan war — UNSC sanctions, Hemedti Dubai property, fading from attention
stories.summary: Not covered this cycle. Iran war dominating UNSC bandwidth. Crisis continues.

stories.label: Pakistan multi-front crisis — border war, now also Iran war fallout
stories.summary: Pakistan now dealing with Iran war fallout domestically (9 dead in protests, curfews) while border clashes with Afghanistan continue. PM cancelled Russia visit. Multi-front crisis deepening.

stories.label: Sickle cell gene therapy — $2.2M cure inaccessible where disease kills most
stories.summary: Casgevy costs $2.2M. 80% of cases in sub-Saharan Africa. Watch for access advocacy.

stories.label: FBI subpoenas X for Grok prompts used to create deepfake harassment videos
stories.summary: First known case of law enforcement using legal process to get AI prompts as evidence.

stories.label: US orders diplomats to fight data sovereignty initiatives worldwide
stories.summary: State Department ordered diplomats to oppose data localization laws worldwide.

stories.label: Philippines EDSA 40th anniversary protests
stories.summary: Thousands protested on 40th EDSA anniversary. Marcos Jr. faces democratic anger.

stories.label: Sri Lanka arrests ex-intelligence chief over 2019 Easter bombings
stories.summary: Former intelligence chief arrested over 2019 Easter bombings. Seven years of impunity broken.

stories.label: 6.5 million in Somalia face severe hunger as drought deepens
stories.summary: 6.5 million Somalis face severe hunger. Al-Shabaab blocking aid. US funding freezes.

stories.label: WiseTech cuts 2,000 jobs as AI replaces software engineers
stories.summary: WiseTech cutting one-third of workforce attributing layoffs to AI.

stories.label: Iran-US nuclear talks Geneva — ENDED: talks collapsed into war
stories.summary: Superseded by iran-us-israel-war. Talks collapsed into open war.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia war — Russian missile strikes hit 3-year peak in February
stories.summary: AFP analysis: Russian overnight missile strikes on Ukraine reached 3-year peak in February. Russia's attention split between Ukraine and Iran. Belgium/France seized suspected Russian shadow fleet tanker.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — Section 122 tariffs in effect
stories.summary: Fading. Iran war reshaping trade dynamics. Oil price spike and Gulf disruption more significant than tariff mechanics now.

stories.label: ICC prosecution: Duterte drew up death lists for drug war
stories.summary: Fading. ICC hearing in procedural phase.

stories.label: Mexico CJNG crisis — aftermath of El Mencho death
stories.summary: Fading. Situation reportedly stabilized.
